doc: A parcel of a map (design/map.md, The plan): a seed point with a reach and a character; every cell belongs to the parcel nearest it (by distance less its reach, warped by noise).

fields.name: reach
fields.doc: How far it reaches beyond its neighbours, metres: added to its share of the partition.

fields.name: plotter
fields.doc: The plotter that grows its nature (a plotters/ name; empty: none).

fields.name: relief
fields.doc: How high its hills stand, metres.

fields.name: hill_size
fields.doc: How wide a hill is, metres.

fields.name: cliffs
fields.doc: How much steep land breaks into rock faces, 0 to 1.

fields.name: caves
fields.doc: How often tall faces open into caves, 0 to 1.

fields.name: woods
fields.doc: How much of it is wooded, 0 to 1: the far land's canopy colour (its plotter grows the real trees near).
